captions_note: the title is the caption for its span: hide the reel's captions there, or build with CAPTIONS=0
steps: run build.py      # 1. measure, place, time, plan, sounds, index.html. READ the printout
run bake.py --frames 40,62,95 -g      # 2. preview the frames it suggests -> work/t/ (red lines = safe zone)
run bake.py      # 3. assets/fx.mp4, 9 to 15 s per second of slot (6 cores)
run post.py      # 5. frame count, edge colour, phone copy, stills, work/qa/sheet_*.jpg
